question: Does the original frozen judge lower its signed soft preference when one quality-tied R1 is degraded along a dimension not used by the unchanged debate?
selection: Equal existing archived R1 overall scores; user explicitly rejects re-scoring baseline ties.

pilot.purpose: Establish feasible quality degradation without changing debate applicability; failure does not permit weakening acceptance.
pilot.tie_confirmation: Existing archived R1 scores only; no new baseline tie calls
pilot.acceptance: Unchanged mechanical reward/rule/penalty and sentence-word-count summary; lower independent craft rating in both orders; claim-level invariance audit and source review.

full_target.scope: Only after pilot validation and frozen runtime spec; retain all attempted/rejected edits. No extrapolation from candidate count to eligible count.

intervention.story_side: Both A and B separately where feasible, never degrade both simultaneously; failed-side attempts retained. Primary average within original pair, then prompt cluster.
preserve: all event/entity/action facts referenced by either side
truth status and applicability of already incorrect claims
programmatic rule scores and penalties where feasible; primary acceptance requires unchanged task metrics
intervention.change: Quality dimension unmentioned by the debate, preferably imagery or fluency; inspect all qualitative claims to exclude contradictions. Do not assume edit type guarantees orthogonality.
intervention.quality_validation: Blind original/edited comparison in both orders, separate from edit generation; same V4 model/provider; require independently confirmed lower quality and applicable fixed debate. Store failure reasons.

judge.identity: Exact original frozen judge adapter/hash/harness/label contract from hdhyhpsy; not V4 as replacement
judge.score: s=tanh((z_forward-z_reverse)/4), z=log P(A)-log P(B) with semantic whitespace token aggregation
judge.primary_effect: delta_s_target=orientation*(s_edited-s_original), orientation +1 for A edit and -1 for B edit; negative favors the unchanged competitor
measurements: matched fresh original/edited s in both display orders
raw semantic label probabilities and logits

inference: Paired 10000 prompt-cluster bootstrap; mirrored sides/orders not independent. Report exact denominator, quality drops, audit exclusions; optional s-vs-quality dose description is exploratory.

resources.proposed_host: idle vm02 or vm03, Raul isolated directory only

orthogonality_limit: Operationally audited invariance, not proof of semantic independence. Generic claims of overall superiority may preclude any eligible edit.
